subtitulo: A phone lifted on the metro, a police report that actually counts, and a pharmacy at midnight
introPt: Quiz time. It's half past five in Barcelona, and the afternoon has just gone sideways. A phone goes on the metro, our traveller ends up at the police station, and by midnight he needs a pharmacy that isn't shut. Listen as many times as you like, then answer the questions.
cenario: A traveller has his phone and wallet stolen on the metro, files the report at the comisaría — having started it online the night before — and later that night goes looking for an open pharmacy.

dialogo.pinyin: al lah-DROHN · meh ahn rroh-BAH-dhoh el MOH-beel
dialogo.pt: — Stop, thief! They've stolen my phone! (on the platform)

dialogo.es: Me han robado el móvil y la cartera.
dialogo.pinyin: meh ahn rroh-BAH-dhoh el MOH-beel ee lah kar-TEH-rah
dialogo.pt: — My phone and my wallet have been stolen.

dialogo.es: Ha sido en el metro, hace diez minutos.
dialogo.pinyin: ah SEE-dhoh en el MEH-troh · AH-theh dyeth mee-NOO-tohs
dialogo.pt: — It was on the metro, ten minutes ago.
— I want to file a report.

dialogo.es: Sí. Hice la denuncia por internet. Vengo a ratificarla.
dialogo.pinyin: see · EE-theh lah deh-NOON-thyah por een-tehr-NET · BEN-goh ah rrah-tee-fee-KAR-lah
dialogo.pt: — Yes. I filed it online. I've come to ratify it.

dialogo.es: Necesito una copia para el seguro.
dialogo.pinyin: neh-theh-SEE-toh OO-nah KOH-pyah PAH-rah el seh-GOO-roh
dialogo.pt: — I need a copy for my insurance.

dialogo.es: Muy bien. ¿Le han robado el pasaporte también?
dialogo.pinyin: mwee byen · leh ahn rroh-BAH-dhoh el pah-sah-POR-teh tam-BYEN
dialogo.pt: — Fine. Has your passport been stolen as well?

dialogo.es: No, el pasaporte lo tengo. ¿Hay alguien que hable inglés?
dialogo.pinyin: noh · el pah-sah-POR-teh loh TEN-goh · ai AL-gyen keh AH-bleh een-GLEHS
dialogo.pt: — No, I've got my passport. Is there anyone who speaks English?

dialogo.es: Sí, ahora llamo a un compañero.
dialogo.pinyin: see · ah-OH-rah YAH-moh ah oon kom-pah-NYEH-roh
dialogo.pt: — Yes, I'll call a colleague now.

dialogo.es: ¿Hay una farmacia de guardia por aquí? Me duele la cabeza.
dialogo.pinyin: ai OO-nah far-MAH-thyah deh GWAR-dhyah por ah-KEE · meh DWEH-leh lah kah-BEH-thah
dialogo.pt: — (that night) Is there a duty pharmacy near here? I've got a headache.

dialogo.es: Sí, hay una en la calle Mayor. Mire la puerta: la lista está ahí.
dialogo.pinyin: see · ai OO-nah en lah KAH-yeh mah-YOR · MEE-reh lah PWEHR-tah · lah LEES-tah ehs-TAH ah-EE
dialogo.pt: — Yes, there's one on Calle Mayor. Look at the door: the list is right there.

perguntas.pergunta: What exactly did he report stolen?
perguntas.es: What exactly did he report stolen?
perguntas.explica: 'Me han robado el móvil y la cartera.' The template is 'Me han robado' plus the thing — and in Spain the phone is 'el móvil', never 'celular'.
perguntas.pt: 'Me han robado el móvil y la cartera.' The template is 'Me han robado' plus the thing — and in Spain the phone is 'el móvil', never 'celular'.

perguntas.pergunta: 'Ha sido en el metro, hace diez minutos.' What two things is he giving the officer?
perguntas.es: 'Ha sido en el metro, hace diez minutos.' What two things is he giving the officer?
opcoes: The line number and the station
perguntas.explica: Where and when — the only two facts the report actually needs. Have them ready before you reach the counter and the whole thing takes minutes.
perguntas.pt: Where and when — the only two facts the report actually needs. Have them ready before you reach the counter and the whole thing takes minutes.

perguntas.pergunta: He already filed online last night. So what is he at the station to do?
perguntas.es: He already filed online last night. So what is he at the station to do?
opcoes: Cancel the online report and start again
Sign it in person so it becomes a real report
Pay a fee for the report
perguntas.explica: 'Vengo a ratificarla.' Filing online is half a denuncia — it becomes real when you sign it in person, and the clock is short. Check the confirmation e-mail for the deadline and go the same day if you can.
perguntas.pt: 'Vengo a ratificarla.' Filing online is half a denuncia — it becomes real when you sign it in person, and the clock is short. Check the confirmation e-mail for the deadline and go the same day if you can.

perguntas.pergunta: Why does he ask for 'una copia'?
perguntas.es: Why does he ask for 'una copia'?
perguntas.explica: 'Necesito una copia para el seguro.' No denuncia, no claim — and a screenshot of the online form is not the same document. Ask before you leave the counter.
perguntas.pt: 'Necesito una copia para el seguro.' No denuncia, no claim — and a screenshot of the online form is not the same document. Ask before you leave the counter.

perguntas.pergunta: That night the pharmacy is shut. What does 'de guardia' mean — and where is the list?
perguntas.es: That night the pharmacy is shut. What does 'de guardia' mean — and where is the list?
opcoes: A pharmacy with a security guard; ask at the hotel
A hospital pharmacy; it's inside A and E
The pharmacy on the night rota; the list is stuck on the door of the closed one
A pharmacy that only sells prescriptions; ask a doctor
perguntas.explica: Spain runs a rota rather than 24-hour chemists. Found one shut? Don't walk away — read the door. Tonight's duty pharmacy is printed on the glass.
perguntas.pt: Spain runs a rota rather than 24-hour chemists. Found one shut? Don't walk away — read the door. Tonight's duty pharmacy is printed on the glass.

perguntas.pergunta: You're leaving a department store and see a big sign saying SALIDA. What is it telling you?
perguntas.es: You're leaving a department store and see a big sign saying SALIDA. What is it telling you?
perguntas.explica: SALIDA is the exit — the number one false friend for an English speaker. The sale is REBAJAS. And at the airport, SALIDAS in the plural means departures.
perguntas.pt: SALIDA is the exit — the number one false friend for an English speaker. The sale is REBAJAS. And at the airport, SALIDAS in the plural means departures.

perguntas.pergunta: The bar door says TIRAR. What do you do?
perguntas.es: The bar door says TIRAR. What do you do?
perguntas.explica: TIRAR is pull, however much it looks like 'tear' or 'throw'. EMPUJAR is push — em-PU-jar, PUsh. Between them they cause the daily doorway collision.
perguntas.pt: TIRAR is pull, however much it looks like 'tear' or 'throw'. EMPUJAR is push — em-PU-jar, PUsh. Between them they cause the daily doorway collision.
